programme: BTech in Computer Science and Engineering
source: IIT Bhilai Courses of Study, October 2026; applicable from the 2023 batch onwards
limitations: The main catalogue contains only named BTech CSE courses from the source-backed curriculum schedule, not every institute-wide course.
Prerequisites, elective eligibility, semester credit caps, course offerings, workload estimates, and course-to-skill mappings are not established by the supplied source.
The source prints SL302 in the BTech PC list and CSL302 in the semester sequence and course catalogue; CSL302 is preserved from the latter, with the discrepancy documented.
The source states 144 graded credits plus 12 non-graded core units; it does not provide credit values for those non-graded units.
unsupported_features: Automated degree-audit or graduation eligibility decisions
